credentialRequirements.description: Authenticated Coinbase Agentic Wallet session managed by the upstream Payments MCP application. Payment, transfer, and trade capabilities are subject to the wallet account’s configured spending limits and supported networks.

make_http_request_with_x402.description: Call a paid API endpoint with automatic USDC payment. For bazaar services, call bazaar_get_resource_details first to get the schema and costs. For non-bazaar endpoints, call discover_x402_payment_requirements first. If the endpoint requires parameters, ask the user to provide them — pass them in body (POST/PUT/PATCH) or queryParams (GET). Payment amounts are in USDC atomic units (6 decimals). 1,000,000 atomic units = $1.00 USDC. Use preferredNetwork to force payment settlement on a specific chain (e.g., "solana" to pay via Solana instead of EVM). Use preferredScheme to choose exact, upto, batch-settlement, or auth-capture when the endpoint advertises multiple schemes.

headers.description: Optional custom HTTP headers to include in the request

correlationId.description: Optional correlation ID to group related x402 operations together

maxAmountPerRequest.description: Optional max amount per request in USDC atomic units (1000000 = $1.00)

paymentRequirements.description: Optional payment requirements from discovery endpoint - when provided, skips initial 402 discovery

preferredNetwork.description: Force payment settlement on a specific network. When an endpoint supports multiple networks (e.g., both EVM and Solana), this selects the matching payment requirement. Without this, the first available requirement is used.

preferredScheme.description: Force a payment scheme when the endpoint advertises multiple options. Supported values: "exact", "upto", "batch-settlement", "auth-capture".

extensions.description: Pre-fetched PaymentRequired extensions (e.g., bazaar resource details). Takes precedence over extensions returned by live discovery; discovery still runs unless paymentRequirements is also provided.

send.description: Send USDC, ETH, or SOL to a recipient. Accepts Ethereum addresses (0x...), ENS names (e.g. vitalik.eth), or Solana addresses. Amount must be in atomic units: USDC $1 = 1,000,000 | ETH 1 = 10^18 | SOL 1 = 10^9. Subject to the user's configured spending limits. Supports ENS names (e.g., vitalik.eth) and hex addresses (0x...). Transactions are subject to spending limits set in the wallet app. Supported chains: base (default), base-sepolia, polygon, solana, solana-devnet. IMPORTANT: This executes a real financial transaction. Only call this tool when the user has explicitly requested to send tokens, with a clear recipient and amount. Always confirm the recipient address, asset, and amount with the user before calling.

recipient.description: Recipient address (0x... for EVM, Base58 for Solana) or ENS domain

amountAtomic.description: Amount in the asset's atomic units. USDC: 6 decimals (1000000 = $1.00). ETH: 18 decimals (wei). SOL: 9 decimals (lamports)

asset.description: Asset to send: USDC (default), ETH, SOL

chain.description: Blockchain network: base, base-sepolia, polygon, solana, solana-devnet (default: base).

sign_in_with_email.description: Start email sign-in by sending a 6-digit verification code to the provided email address. Returns a flowId needed to complete sign-in via verify_email_otp. After calling this, ask the user for the 6-digit code from their email, then call verify_email_otp.

trade.description: Swap between tokens on EVM chains. Supports USDC↔ETH on Base and USDC↔POL on Polygon. Solana swaps are not supported. Amount is in atomic units based on the token decimals. Supported token aliases on Base: usdc, eth. On Polygon: usdc, pol. You can also use contract addresses (0x...). Amount can be human-readable (e.g., "$1.00", "0.50") or in atomic units. Supported chains: base (default), base-sepolia, polygon. IMPORTANT: This executes a real token swap on-chain. Only call this tool when the user has explicitly requested a trade or swap, with clear token pair and amount. Always confirm the trade details with the user before calling.

fromToken.description: Source token: alias (usdc, eth on Base; usdc, pol on Polygon) or contract address (0x...)

toToken.description: Destination token: alias (usdc, eth on Base; usdc, pol on Polygon) or contract address (0x...)

fromAmount.description: Amount to swap in human-readable format (e.g., "$1.00", "0.50") or atomic units

chain.description: Blockchain network: base, base-sepolia, polygon (default: base).

slippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points (100 = 1%, max: 500 = 5%, default: 100)

verify_email_otp.description: Complete email sign-in by submitting the 6-digit code the user received. Requires the flowId returned by sign_in_with_email. Use the flowId from sign_in_with_email and the 6-digit code the user received.
